summary: The actual flutter_secure_storage macOS plugin successfully wrote, read, and deleted a disposable value using ApiClient's isolated legacy-Keychain options in the sandboxed macOS integration-test app. This closes the plugin-level ad-hoc Debug round-trip check without touching an account session cookie.

checks.name: macOS Keychain plugin round-trip
checks.observation: The macOS app built and launched; the plugin returned null before write, the exact disposable value after write, and null after delete. A finally block deletes the QA key on failure. No login, session cookie, or existing Keychain item was accessed.

remaining: This proves the isolated legacy-Keychain plugin round-trip in an ad-hoc Debug app only. Verify a successful account login writes a session cookie and restores it after relaunch, and separately verify a Developer ID-signed Release build; no user session was disturbed for this test.
